titulo: Why The Rich Get Richer (Explained With One Chicken) 🐔
descripcion:
Everyone on Earth starts again with one chicken. One guy eats his. One keeps his for the eggs. One finds a rooster and multiplies them. A year later: the poor, the middle class and the rich. Your paycheck is your chicken. Eat it, keep it, or make it multiply. Which one are you? 👇

#shorts #money #moneytips #rich #financialfreedom #mindset #investing #animation #story #explained #fyp
